3135.problem: Write a for loop generating the De Bruijn sequence for alphabet size 2 and order 3 by following the De Bruijn graph.
3135.answer:
local db = []
local dbState = [0,0,0]
local dbVisited = []
local dbSteps = 0
while (dbSteps < 8) {
  local key = dbState.join("")
  if (!dbVisited.containsItem(key)) {
    dbVisited.add(key)
  }
  local newBit = (dbState[1] + dbState[2]) % 2
  db.add(dbState[3])
  dbState = [newBit, dbState[1], dbState[2]]
  dbSteps = dbSteps + 1
}
println(db)
